newsitem.title: USA: ING unit enters Computer Sciences deal.
newsitem.headline: ING unit enters Computer Sciences deal.

text.p: ING Financial Services International North America said on Tuesday it entered a 10-year agreement for mainframe and other technology outsourcing with Computer Sciences Corp.
The agreement, valued at $250 million, affects facilities in the United States and Canada for ING FSI-NA, a regional operation for Amsterdam-based ING Group, ING Financial said.

A related agreement with a Computer Sciences affiliate will also provide systems application development at Security Life of Denver Insurance Company, a Colorado-based business unit of ING FSI-NA, the company said.

ING said 115 employees in technology related positions will be affected by the move. The company is not sure if any job losses would take place, but an estimated 6O ING employees will join Computer Sciences as part of the contract.
Terms of the agreement with ING FSI-NA call for Computer Sciences to consolidate ING's Atlanta and Denver data center operations into Computer Sciences' San Diego location.
Canadian data center operations for ING will be consolidated at Saint- Hyacinthe in Quebec province.
For ING's U.S.-based life insurance companies, Computer Sciences will automate and streamline help-desk functions and manage all desktop support; and oversee local area network services
The multi-year CSC Continuum service agreement with Security Life has a potential value of more than $35 million.
